notes.title: QOL Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello beloved steam players! No, the full game is not out yet.  [/p][p]Yes I am still working on it. Now that we got this out of the way, let's get into the new changes: [/p][p]-Added a way to change the options on the title screen. [/p][p]-Added a proper game-over screen. Previous one was a white screen with no music.(Special thanks to Solar for the art and Mir for the game over track) [/p][p]-Fixed broken dialogues that didn't display fully on screen. [/p][p]-Added a "speedrun" event in the starting area if you already knew some info beforehand. [/p][p]-Added an fps counter (Toggle it with the F2 key...if you really want an fps counter.) [/p][p]-Fixed a bug in the hall of pillars that prevented you from progressing. [/p][p]-Revamped the tutorial [/p][p]-Removed Decav. Forever. (he is now a 1/100 chance event)  Sadly, no art this time. If you want to make some and become featured here, consider messaging me on Twitter! That's where I post updates and whatnot ([url="https://x.com/CHIOR_dev"]https://x.com/CHIOR_dev[/url])[/p]

notes.title: State of Chior
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, everyone! We hope you're having a fantastic day.[/p][p]As you may have noticed, Chior: Chapter 1 went free-to-play a few days ago, and naturally, you might be wondering: [i]"What happens now?"[/i] Well, here’s a short list of what’s going on:[/p][list][*][p][b]Players who purchased the game before it became free-to-play will receive a copy of the full game once it’s released.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Development is not slowing down—in fact, it's accelerating! The developer, Darius (debt collector), is working hard on future installments.[/p][/*][*][p]The full game, which you can wishlist now, will be released as a separate app for those who downloaded Chapter 1 for free.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your support![/p][p]Link to the full game's store page:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3808310/Chior/?curator_clanid=45168463"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]As always here is some awesome fan art, this time created by Solar:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175736/4ca393736836b0e9e1c4cce504e15d941fcfd6a0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]
